verdict.rationale: Perplexity is driven by natural-language input: users ask questions by typing or speaking, the Assistant takes natural-language requests to draft emails, schedule appointments and book reservations, and Computer accepts delegated multi-step tasks and runs browser sessions on its own. A hands-on report says the agentic Computer feature often fails to trigger from the UI and its sessions frequently stall, and there is no evidence that natural language can control product settings, library management or configuration. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over product configuration and management (not just queries and tasks), reliable hands-on corroboration of the agentic Computer and Assistant command execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Assistant: Draft emails, schedule appointments, book reservations, and more.
Voice: Instant, up-to-date answers whether you type or say it.
Quick Queries: Ask any question directly from your toolbar—no need to jump between tabs.
When a task requires interacting with a website, filling forms, or accessing login-gated content, Computer launches a browser session automatically.
